Choose original rate4, I_X=(I(b)+I(c))/2, D=H(G)-(H(b)+H(c))/2, r4=4I_X-H(G), and inherit original squared-spectral marginals at every physical restriction. For every finite adaptive physical stopping forest below z, its complete actual entropy-drop-minus4-influence debit E_H obeys r4-E_H>m/2-25/12-(2m^2+2m-1)/(4*2^m)>=455/768. Every outcome, old D, actual removed influence J and both full terminal CE/KL bills are retained; no renewal or reset. Units bits.
